main_text.head: IN TRACTATUM IPSUM Cardinalis BELLARMINI, De Officio Principis Christiani, ANIMADVERSIONES.
CAP. I.
Partitio totius Operis.
main_text.p: In fine Præf. ad Lect. & initio Lib.
main_text.head: I. ANIMADVERSIO.

head.i: Partitionem hanc nonnullam sinistra mentis suspicionem ingerere.

main_text.p: SECT. I.Vereor equidem, nec sanè immeritò, ne Partitio hæc omnibus Principibus inuidiosa, atque etiam, ex amphibolia huius vocis [Svperiorvs] infidiosa nimis videri possit; vtpote quâ à Republica ciues germani; à Regibus natiui Subditi, ceu vel [illegible, ~3 letters] ac germana membra à Corpore, vel à capite partes subiectæ[?] distrahantur prorsus atque diuellantur. Agè vero (Te obsecro,) Bellarmine; dicito ecquem in suis Regnis Principibus ipsis omninò Superiorem constituere vobis fas erit, præter Regem Regum immortalem solum Deum?

page.notes: The top-right "SECT. I." is a margin marker, placed here with the first paragraph. The word after "vel" is unreadable. "subiectæ" is doubtful: the scan shows a damaged letter group. "deuls" in the numbered list is doubtful. The line "Diuiditur in quatuor Confiderationes" has printed spelling kept as shown.
